## Adversarial findings — UNAVAILABLE (mandatory chain outage)

The all-rate-limited exhaustion (exit 12) was remapped by the helper to exit 9 because review is mandatory, so no opinion was obtained. The review is `unavailable`; graft should park before opening a PR, and the merge floor refuses this verdict.

### critical: Mandatory adversarial review chain outage
